name: vibe-studio
description: Vibe Studio skill pack for planning and building a new app or web product: idea, benchmark research, brand voice, design brand fitting, and user flows — written as PRODUCT.md, BENCHMARK.md, VOICE.md, DESIGN.md, FLOWS.md with an HTML report for each in docs/report/ and decisions logged in DECISIONS.md — then a build loop over work bundles in docs/work/: build-spec (SETUP.md and one bundle folder with SPEC.md), build-slice (build and verify one slice at a time), and build-check (end-to-end QA in the bundle's REVIEW.md).

interface.shortDescription: Plan and build new app and web products, one user flow at a time.
interface.longDescription: Vibe Studio bundles a staged product planning workflow for new app and web ideas: brainstorming, benchmark research with competitor screen captures, brand voice, design-system brand fitting, and user-flow generation, each writing a markdown source file plus a readable HTML report and logging decisions to DECISIONS.md. Building then runs as a loop over work bundles — usually one flow, sometimes a cross-flow job like making login real or moving stacks: build-spec slices the bundle into small, checkable pieces in docs/work/<NN-name>/SPEC.md; build-slice builds one piece at a time with the design and voice, checks it in the browser, and commits; build-check walks the whole flow like a first-time user and records blockers, mismatches, and security risks in the bundle's REVIEW.md.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a new app or web service with the Vibe Studio workflow.
